goal: Enforce bounds checking on numeric configuration options during node startup
Fail fast with fatal errors instead of silently wrapping, overflowing, or misconfiguring node behavior
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Concept approval for parsing improvements and closing misconfigurations (l0rinc, ryanofsky)
Approach NACK wanting validation handled centrally in the args handler rather than piecemeal (sedited)
Unaddressed objection that parsing as i64 breaks chrono handling and should be u32 (maflcko)
Unaddressed objection to increasing DISALLOW_NEGATION use and its inconsistent UX (ryanofsky)
Unaddressed objection that a test loop binding to temporary strings breaks CI (l0rinc)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because bounds checking stops negative datacarriersize from permitting unlimited OP_RETURN sizes
It prevents negative or huge mempoolexpiry from overflowing time calculations

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because catching invalid startup arguments prevents silent integer wrap-around and logic inversion
Failing on bad options protects operators, though piecemeal checks limit leverage

categories.name: wallet
why: P4 because rejecting out-of-range txconfirmtarget values stops unexpected fallbacks to fallbackfee
It resolves a narrow edge-case misconfiguration without altering standard wallet operation
